values.head: THE FIELD
values.body: ReadyCounter already parsed one hundred forty eight popular DTC brands. Seventy eight opened a public feed. Width, not a vanity score in a vacuum.

values.head: SCRAPE ≠ PROTOCOL
values.body: Zero percent barcodes in what agents scrape. Eleven brands still return GTIN on Shopify UCP Catalog MCP where scrape is empty.

values.head: THE LOOP
values.body: Paste a URL. Fix something. Re-audit. We print the delta. Every point on the sandbox bill traces to a published abandonment share.

values.head: PROOF
values.body: Human and agent, one cart. prepare_checkout never charges a card. Open source. Live now.
